scope: Read-only GLB and source verification. No rendering, gameplay acceptance, fit acceptance, or production promotion.

policy.upperRobe: Every original R13 cloth sample at y >= 1.08 remains exact, with duplicate counts preserved. Added cloth samples are required and limited to the approved front underlay bounds. Scales, lining/backings, and metal/thread trim may change and are reported.

approvedRobeCoverageChange.reason: Hide covered native upper-chest triangles that protrude through the authored robe during walking.

policy.preservedDefect: Only existing zero-length hood lining normals may remain. All other normals must be finite unit vectors.
policy.limits: Bounds and changed samples do not establish garment fit, relief, clearance, movement quality, or visual acceptance.
